index.html.title: IKE Workspace Extension
index.html.body:
IKE Workspace Extension [1] network.ike.tooling:ike-workspace-extension is a Maven 4 build extension that prunes non-existent <subprojects> entries from IKE workspace POMs before model validation. Lets a fresh clone of any IKE workspace bootstrap with mvn ws:scaffold-init even when no subproject directory is on disk yet. What it does When Maven 4 reads a workspace POM declaring several subprojects but the working tree only has the workspace root (because the operator just ran git clone and has not yet populated subprojects), Maven’s model validator fatally aborts the build with "Child subproject X does not exist" — before any goal can run. That makes the documented bootstrap (git clone && cd && mvn ws:scaffold-init) impossible. See IKE-Network/ike-issues#459[2]. This extension implements org.apache.maven.api.spi.ModelTransformer.transformFileModel, which fires before profile activation and subproject existence validation. For any POM whose directory has a sibling workspace.yaml (the "this is a workspace POM" marker), the transformer: Removes <subprojects> entries whose <sub>/pom.xml does not exist on disk. Removes file-activated profiles whose <file><exists> target is missing — so any -P?with-X flag on the command line silently no-ops on the missing profile name. Every other POM passes through untouched. Build lock and missing-module diagnosis Every working-set build takes an exclusive OS file lock on <root>/.mvn/target/build.lock when project discovery starts and holds it until the session ends. A second build of the same tree waits, saying every 30 seconds who holds the lock (pid, host, start time, goals and -pl), and fails after -Dike.build.lock.timeout (default 30m; PT45M, 90s, 2h also work) with the holder named. A member built from its own root locks its working set’s tree. -Dike.build.lock=false skips the lock, and so do sessions whose goals are all read-only (validate, help:*, dependency:tree/list/resolve, ws:*-draft). Only the outer Maven session locks: a Maven started by the holder (exec, the invoker, a ws: goal running mvn) finds its ancestor in the lock file and proceeds unlocked. The OS releases the lock when the holder exits, Ctrl-C and crashes included, so a dead build never wedges the tree. IntelliJ’s Maven sync neither takes nor waits for the lock; IDE builds take it only when delegated to Maven. When a compile fails with javac module not found: X, or a test fork with NoClassDefFoundError/ClassNotFoundException for a reactor sibling’s class, the extension logs a diagnosis (and saves it under .mvn/target/ike-diagnostics/): the sibling’s target/classes, whether the class or module-info.class is there and when it was written relative to the build’s start and to this session’s own compile of the sibling, the file the dependency resolved to (reactor class directory, packaged jar, project-local repository, or local repository), and other processes working in the tree. It tells an outside writer apart from Maven resolving or ordering the sibling wrongly (MNG-8096). Stability commitment This artifact does exactly one thing and never grows. The dependency surface stays at the Maven 4 API jars (compile scope, loaded into the extension classloader), plus maven-core (provided) for the session-level build lock and diagnosis. No ike-* runtime dependencies, no business logic, no knowledge of IKE conventions beyond "sibling workspace.yaml marks a workspace POM." Versioned independently of the ike-platform[3] release cadence. If we ever need different behavior, we add a separate extension rather than evolving this one. Wiring Declared in a workspace’s .mvn/extensions.xml: <extensions>
    <extension>
        <groupId>network.ike.tooling</groupId>
        <artifactId>ike-workspace-extension</artifactId>
        <version>1</version>
    </extension>
</extensions> The ike-platform workspace plugin’s ws:scaffold-init writes this entry into new workspaces automatically; ws:scaffold-publish keeps it in sync on existing workspaces. The version is sourced from a property declared in ike-parent — operators do not maintain it by hand. Coordinates <dependency>
    <groupId>network.ike.tooling</groupId>
    <artifactId>ike-workspace-extension</artifactId>
    <version>1</version>
</dependency> Available from Maven Central. Tracking IKE-Network/ike-issues#460[4] — productionization plan IKE-Network/ike-issues#459[2] — underlying defect this extension fixes

summary.html.title: Project Summary
summary.html.body: Project Summary Project Information Field Value Name IKE Workspace Extension Description Maven 4 build extension that prunes non-existent <subprojects> entries from workspace POMs before model validation. Lets a fresh clone of an IKE workspace bootstrap with mvn ws:scaffold-init before any subproject directory is on disk. Homepage https://ike.network/ike-workspace-extension/[1] Project Organization Field Value Name IKE Network URL https://ike.network[2] Build Information Field Value GroupId network.ike.tooling ArtifactId ike-workspace-extension Version 15 Type jar Java Version -

team.html.title: Project Team
team.html.body: Project Team A successful project requires many people to play many roles. Some members write code or documentation, while others are valuable as testers, submitting patches and suggestions. The project team is comprised of Members and Contributors. Members have direct access to the source of a project and actively evolve the code-base. Contributors improve the project through submission of patches and suggestions to the Members. project-info.html.body: Project Information This document provides an overview of the various documents and links that are part of this project's general information. All of this content is automatically generated by Maven[1] on behalf of the project. Overview Document Description Dependencies[2] This document lists the project's dependencies and provides information on each dependency. Maven Coordinates[3] This document describes how to include this project as a dependency using various dependency management tools. Distribution Management[4] This document provides informations on the distribution management of this project. About[5] Maven 4 build extension that prunes non-existent <subprojects> entries from workspace POMs before model validation. Lets a fresh clone of an IKE workspace bootstrap with mvn ws:scaffold-init before any subproject directory is on disk. Licenses[6] This document lists the project license(s).
